Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting smoking in vehicles containing children.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to operating a motor vehicle while smoking; addinga new section to chapter 46.61 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person who smokes a lighted pipe, cigar, or cigarette in amoving or parked motor vehicle containing any passengers under the ageof eighteen years is guilty of a traffic infraction. (2) Enforcement of this section by law enforcement officers may beaccomplished only as a secondary action when a driver of a motorvehicle has been detained for a suspected violation of this title or anequivalent local ordinance or some other offense. (3) Infractions under this section shall not become part of thedriver's record under RCW 46.52.101 and 46.52.120. Additionally, afinding that a person has committed a traffic infraction under thissection shall not be made available to insurance companies oremployers.
